summary: Tested scraper failed-item retry override/limit backend + frontend behavior. Requested flows pass, but critical auth gap found on scraper schedule/retry APIs.

critical.issue: Endpoints are accessible without admin authentication. Reproduced via public curl returning 200 for schedule and processing retry-failed validation without auth.

action_items: Add admin auth guards (Depends(get_current_admin)) to scraper schedule/retry mutating and read endpoints.
Re-test unauthenticated access returns 401/403 after auth guard fix.
Keep request_limit validation and retry defer semantics unchanged while applying auth fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Requested P0 behavior is implemented: RetryFailedBody accepts optional provider_id and optional request_limit (null allowed, ge=1 enforced), and helper request_limit logic defers untouched IDs while keeping them failed.
Regression checks passed for manual item retry + scheduled auto-retry queueing behavior in test_scheduler_history_and_retry.py.
server.py is very large (>5000 lines), increasing regression risk; consider further modular split for schedule/scraper auth boundaries.

success_rate.backend: 93% (15/15 targeted tests passed, plus 1 critical unauthenticated-access defect found by live endpoint probe)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (requested retry-control visibility + payload serialization checks passed)

seed_data_creation: Created MOCKED scraper schedule last_run_results for UI verification, then cleaned all mock rows in cleanup script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI verification used qa@prettycheap.com.au / QaTest123!. MOCKED provider/eBay behavior preserved (no live third-party scraping). Retry-control payload capture confirmed: blank limit -> null, numeric limit -> integer. Cleaned temporary ui-mock-* schedule rows after test.
rca of the issue: Root cause of critical defect: scraper schedule/retry endpoints (e.g., /api/scraper/schedule, /api/scraper/retry-failed) are defined without admin auth dependency, so public callers can read scheduler state and attempt retry actions. Repro: curl GET /api/scraper/schedule returns 200 without cookie/token; curl POST /api/scraper/retry-failed with body validates and responds without auth. Mitigation: enforce Depends(get_current_admin) consistently across scraper schedule and retry routes; add auth regression tests for 401/403 unauthenticated requests.
